info.title: Sportspark Operating API
info.description: Versioned, command-oriented API for the Sportspark facility operating platform. Organization context is derived from the authenticated principal, never from request identifiers.

PaymentAttemptStatus.description: created and processing: the payment is on its way, the payer waits (nextAction await_payment_confirmation). action_required: the provider asks the payer to act (complete_payment_action); no other status asks the payer anything. unknown: the outcome is not known yet; do not pay again until it is reconciled (await_reconciliation, SPK-PAY-007). succeeded, failed and canceled are final.

AccountingBatchStatus.description: prepared: lines chosen, not sent. submitted: handed to the accounting connection. unknown: no answer; the reconciliation job asks again and never sends a second batch. accepted and rejected are the connection's answers (rejected lines can be exported again). canceled: a prepared batch withdrawn before sending.

PosProductKind.description: What a point-of-sale product is. Registrations, memberships, packages and bookings are never POS products (SPK-PAY-012).
